title: •Twi’lek Advisor
caption: •Twi’lek Advisor (V)
game_text:
USED: Use 3 Force to deploy a unique (•) alien (for free) from hand or Used Pile; reshuffle.
STARTING: ▲ and/or ▼ up to three Effects of any kind with “Jabba” in lore or game text. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
copyright: TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip heading and strip (Twi’lek). Banner USED OR STARTING INTERRUPT. USED:/STARTING: lines separated by \n as the slip prints them. Slip prints ▲ and ▼ where the stub expands 'Take into hand…' / 'Deploy on table…'; the stub's '(*)' is the bullet '(•)' on the slip; curly double quotes around “Jabba”. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes and curly apostrophe (wiki 'He's no Jedi.' with straight single quotes) — confirmed on the 745 px V11 card. Base scan 350 px; copyright 1998 legible on the V11 scan (Hoth-style line). Modern: V11-D-twilekadvisor.gif (745 px) is the PC's Virtual Set 11 Twi’lek Advisor — a DIFFERENT card (new game text) using the same art and lore; used for art only. VB3-D-twilekadvisor-pre.gif (350, the reissue of this slip) also downloaded to src/vs8/modern/45-VB3-D-twilekadvisor-pre.gif.
